flora: Pollen cone (smaller, elongated, dusty with yellow pollen)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; highly geometric, repeating patterns; scales appear thick and 'toylike'; vibrant greens against the dark earth.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant view: Top-Left: The heavy spherical female cone; Top-Right: Close-up of the overlapping scale-leaves; Bottom-Left: A perfectly symmetrical seedling; Bottom-Right: A cluster of male pollen cones.
visual_logic.ground: Dark brown, damp earth with scattered charcoal nodules.
visual_logic.lighting: Diffused top-down lighting to accentuate the 3D relief of the overlapping scales.
